The satellite PNG is drawn from Esri tiles at zoom 16 (about 2.4 m per pixel). It includes the elevation surface at the opacity you set on the map, the contours if they are switched on, the water features, the elevation-coloured profile lines, the legend, a scale bar and a north arrow.

Water features: © OpenStreetMap contributors (Overpass API). Elevation: SRTM 30 m via OpenTopoData (fallback: Open-Elevation). Imagery: Esri World Imagery. SRTM vertical error is roughly ±5 m, which is similar to the total relief in this low coastal area, so drops under about 3 m are flagged as within error. Small paddy drains that nobody has mapped in OSM will not appear.
